added.member: state pseudo-classes after a box pseudo-element
added.summary: `dialog::backdrop:hover`, `select::picker(select):hover` and `::details-content:hover` are accepted and read the pseudo-element's own state: the pointer on the scrim, not on the dialog. `:hover`, `:active`, `:focus`, `:focus-visible`, `:disabled` and `:enabled` may follow `::backdrop`, `::picker(select)`, `::details-content`, `::-og-hold` and `::-og-arrow`. Before, any pseudo-class after a pseudo-element was refused.

The scroll-marker pseudo-classes parse, on an element (`a:target-current`) and after a box pseudo-element. They match what `Ui::set_selector_state` marks; nothing marks an element yet, so they match nothing until scroll markers land.
